_meta.definition: The process of formatting and organizing adverse event data using a standard format, including primary sources and reports

primary_sources._description: Captures details of the original sources and their qualifications for adverse event reports, along with the reporter's country.

columns.name: safetyreportid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the safetyreport entity

columns.name: primarysource_qualification
columns.description: Stores the qualification level of primary sources (1-5), where higher numbers indicate more reliable data.

columns.name: primarysource_reportercountry
columns.description: Stores the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the reporter's country from primary sources.

reports._description: Captures details of adverse event reports submitted to the FDA by various sources.

columns.name: safetyreportid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the safetyreport entity

columns.name: safetyreportversion
columns.description: Stores the version number of safety reports, consistently set to 1 in these samples.

columns.name: receivedate
columns.description: Stores date of report reception as a 4-digit year and 6-digit day (YYYYMMDD format).

columns.name: receivedateformat
columns.description: Stores the repeated format value for the date received of adverse event reports.

columns.name: transmissiondate
columns.description: Stores the date of report transmission as a 4-digit year and 6-digit day (YYYYMMDD) format.

columns.name: transmissiondateformat
columns.description: Stores a repeated integer value representing a specific date format used for report transmissions.

columns.name: receiptdate
columns.description: Stores adverse event report receipt dates as 4-digit year and 6-digit day (YYYYMMDD) format.

columns.name: receiptdateformat
columns.description: Stores the repeated format code for receipt dates in reports.

columns.name: reporttype
columns.description: Stores the type of adverse event report, as all samples indicate a single report type.

columns.name: serious
columns.description: The "serious" column indicates the severity level (1 for serious, 2 for non-serious) of adverse events reported.

columns.name: primarysourcecountry
columns.description: Stores the 10-character ISO country code of the primary source for adverse event reports.

columns.name: occurcountry
columns.description: Stores the 10-character country code for locations where adverse events occurred.

columns.name: companynumb
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for pharmaceutical companies associated with adverse event reports.

columns.name: duplicate
columns.description: The "duplicate" column indicates identical reports within the database.

columns.name: fulfillexpeditecriteria
columns.description: Indicates whether a report meets expedited criteria for FDA review (1 - yes, 2 - no).
